'''Kail Reimo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Bazzel Crimewatch Association]]. He offered several opinions on the actions of the [[Khuiumin Survivors]], after their attacks waned in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], ranging from laying low to catch [[Sector/Legends|sector]] authorities off-guard, or having split their booty and disbanded.
